mechanisms.name: dislocation motion restriction by fine precipitates

evidence.quote: Since the precipitate size and the interparticle spacing is on such a small scale in the solution treated condition, dislocation motion through the matrix is heavily restricted.

mechanisms.name: interparticle spacing control of brittle-to-ductile transition

evidence.quote: The reduction in the brittle-to-ductile transition temperature after aging is believed to be caused by the increase in interparticle spacing between the larger precipitates compared to the solution treated condition.
